source.label: YouTube retention guidance
caveats: A dip can reflect skipping or leaving; a spike can reflect interest or confusion. These patterns do not establish an individual viewer's reason.

evidenceFlow.title: Interpretation basis
evidenceFlow.detail: The official guidance describes intro retention, dips, spikes and reviewing the relevant segment. Cadence's proposed coach separates the measured pattern from possible causes and a next experiment.

queries.summary: Retention changes locate content to inspect; transcript alignment identifies overlapping speech rather than proving that a line caused viewers to leave.

items.title: Timed analytics depends on the actual platform route and evidence

source.label: TikTok Accounts API
caveats: Accounts API access needs application approval, account authorization and scopes; ordinary Display API is a different route.
The inspected endpoint includes paid and organic views; preserve the source's population instead of assuming organic-only data.

queries.summary: The approved Accounts endpoint documents retention by second and percentage, with watch-time/completion fields; its post caption is not a timed speech transcript.

source.label: Meta native and SDK evidence
caveats: The inspected SDK has watch/skip candidates but no retention-curve field; exact current response definitions and API access remain unverified.
Native dashboard availability does not establish third-party API access.

queries.summary: Instagram native retention exists, but automatic timestamp analysis is not established by the API evidence reviewed here.

source.label: LinkedIn video analytics
caveats: Member and organization view definitions differ; the inspected routes list aggregate statistics rather than timeline bins.
Permission for deterministic reporting is separate from permission to process API-derived metrics with AI.

queries.summary: Aggregate watch statistics support explanations but not a precisely located drop-off.

source.label: X media metrics
caveats: Owner-context private metrics have a limited retrieval window and API reads cost money; Cadence's current budget does not fund these reads.

queries.summary: Playback milestones at 0/25/50/75/100 percent locate only broad intervals, not an exact transcript line.

source.label: YouTube later-phase access
caveats: YouTube remains outside Cadence's five-network launch scope.
Caption text needs separate permissions and a usable track; analytics-only authorization is insufficient.

queries.summary: Retention uses normalized intervals; usable timed captions require a separate authorized download.
